headline: Alex Eala Powers Into US Open Third Round With Straight-Sets Win
seoTitle: Alex Eala Reaches US Open Third Round | FMB News
seoDescription: Alex Eala defeated Ukraine’s Oleksandra Oliynykova 6-1, 6-4 to reach the third round of the 2026 US Open, surpassing her previous best run in New York.
deck: The Filipina No. 17 seed defeated Ukraine’s Oleksandra Oliynykova 6-1, 6-4 in New York, booking her first US Open third-round appearance.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Alexandra Eala advanced to the third round of the 2026 US Open after defeating Ukraine’s Oleksandra Oliynykova 6-1, 6-4 in the women’s singles second round in New York on Thursday, September 3, or early Friday, September 4 in the Philippines.

The No. 17 seed controlled the opening set and completed the straight-sets victory in just over an hour. The result sends Eala into the Round of 32 and marks her best US Open singles performance to date.
Eala entered the match after beating American qualifier Mary Stoiana 6-1, 6-2 in the first round.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Eala and Oliynykova had met once previously in 2026, with the Ukrainian winning their Strasbourg Open encounter in three sets. The US Open rematch reversed that result.

Eala arrived in New York after a breakthrough season that included her first WTA singles title in Washington and a fourth-round run at Wimbledon. She is seeded No. 17 at this year’s US Open, the highest Grand Slam seeding of her career.

sections.heading: Why this matters to Filipinos
paragraphs: Eala’s progress gives Philippine tennis another high-profile Grand Slam result and extends a season in which she has broken several national milestones on the WTA Tour.

Her run also carries unusual visibility for Filipino sport in New York, where large groups of Filipino supporters have been attending her matches and drawing attention from international tournament coverage.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Eala will next play in the US Open third round. Her next opponent and match schedule should be confirmed through the official tournament draw and schedule.
A win in the Round of 32 would move her into the second week of the tournament and deepen what is already her strongest US Open campaign.
